name: Shadows of Nagarythe
text: When setting up a battle, up to two fighters from your warband may be kept hidden in reserve. In the second battle round, when it is your turn to activate a fighter, you may reveal and activate one of them instead. Set it up on the battlefield floor within 2" of a terrain piece and more than 6" from enemy fighters.

name: Hatred
text: [Trait] All `SHADOW WARRIORS` fighters have this trait. The folk of Nagarythe never forgave the kin who followed Malekith into the worship of Chaos. Add 1 to this fighter's Fight and Shoot characteristics when making attack actions targeting a `POSSESSED` fighter.

name: Disengage
text: [Double] All `SHADOW WARRIORS` fighters have this ability. A fighter can only use this ability if they are within 1" of an enemy fighter. This fighter makes a free Retreat action.

name: Barbed Arrows
text: [Double] All `SHADOW WARRIORS` fighters have this ability. Add 1 to the Critical Damage characteristic of this fighter's next ranged attack action this activation.

name: Distaste for Poison
text: Poison is the craft of the Dark Elves, and the Shadow Warriors will not touch it. A `SHADOW WARRIORS` warband may not buy Dark Venom or any weapon with the Poisoned special rule.
